title: Diagnosis return
description: Return shape for hektor-failure-diagnosis dispatches (description prefix diagnosis-<...>:). Classifies a single failing test into one of the four root-cause buckets.

classification.description: The four root-cause buckets from hektor-failure-diagnosis.

evidence.description: Artefact paths backing the classification: Selenoid VNC, temp/images screenshots, WebDriver logs, page source, stack trace.

bug-ticket.description: Ticket ID when classification is app-bug.
